data.case_title: Heating Cost Allocator & Water Meter Replacement
data.explanation: This letter is from the metering service your property management has hired to replace the heating cost allocators (Heizkostenverteiler) and water meters in your apartment with wireless devices. An appointment has been set; make sure the technician can reach every radiator as well as the kitchen and bathroom, either by being home yourself or by arranging for someone else to let them in. If the time doesn't work for you, contact the company by phone or online to reschedule. No payment or formal reply is required otherwise.
